_comment: Proposed capability_relations: conservative, directional, TRANSFERABLE-only mappings from adjacent employer concepts to Ty's VERIFIED skills. requirement_concept = what a posting asks; satisfied_by_skill = the exact verified skill that partially supports it. TRANSFERABLE (0.5), never DIRECT: adjacency, not the named discipline. Each is explainable and routes a job to STRETCH review at most (the adjacency guard keeps transferable-only occupational substance out of autonomous APPLICATION_CANDIDATE). Specialist disciplines Ty lacks (revenue operations, sales operations, financial modeling, data/software/security engineering, clinical, legal, accounting) are deliberately ABSENT here and stay REJECT.
